entity: Louisiana's five-year re-inspection rate of large-quantity hazardous-waste generators, ranked against other states
why: The EPA OIG table puts Louisiana at 59% LQG coverage, above its 50% goal, and shows Connecticut (36%), Illinois (48%) and Texas (55%) lower, so the 'last of 28 states' rank breaks. Our Illinois 62.7% and Texas 66.5% are also more than 25% off the OIG's 48% and 55%. The low-coverage direction for Louisiana partially matched.
